title: Interpretable and Accurate Hybrid Decision Trees with Selective Case-Based Splits
abstract: arXiv:2611.34887v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Decision trees are among the most well-known interpretable models in Machine Learning. Over the years, a wide variety of strategies have been proposed to define split conditions within the greedy learning framework, aiming to guide instance routing and enhance predictive performance. These strategies range from axis-parallel and oblique splits based on feature values to proximity-based splits using exemplar instances and more complex hybrid approaches. However, no single method has emerged as universally superior. In this work, we present two key contributions to the construction of greedy decision trees. First, we propose a hybrid tree architecture that integrates both feature-based and case-based splits, allowing for heterogeneous splits throughout the tree. Second, we introduce a novel type of split that leverages a selective case-based approach: when a split is needed, our method searches for the most informative subset of features

translated_title: 基于选择性案例分割的可解释且准确的混合决策树
translated_abstract: 决策树是机器学习中最著名的可解释模型之一。多年来，人们提出了各种各样的策略来定义贪婪学习框架内的分割条件，旨在指导实例路由并提高预测性能。这些策略包括基于特征值的轴平行和倾斜分割、使用范例实例的基于邻近性的分割，以及更复杂的混合方法。然而，没有任何一种方法被证明是普遍优越的。在这项工作中，我们对贪婪决策树的构建提出了两个关键贡献。首先，我们提出了一种混合树架构，它集成了基于特征的分割和基于案例的分割，允许在整个树中进行异构分割。其次，我们引入了一种新颖的分割类型，该分割类型利用了选择性的基于案例的方法：当需要分割时，我们的方法会搜索最具信息量的特征子集。
tldr: 这篇论文提出了一种集成基于特征分割和基于案例分割的混合决策树架构，并引入了一种新颖的选择性基于案例的分割方法，通过搜索最具信息量的特征子集来构建既可解释又准确的决策树。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hybrid decision tree architecture integrating both feature-based and case-based splits, and introduces a novel selective case-based split approach that searches for the most informative subset of features to build interpretable and accurate decision trees.
